description: This file defines protocols for streaming audio playback, specifically 'StreamingAudioPlaying' and 'PCMStreamingAudioPlaying', and provides extensions for classes 'StreamingAudioPlayer' and 'PCMStreamingAudioPlayer' to conform to these protocols.

classes.name: StreamingAudioPlayer
classes.description: Class conforming to StreamingAudioPlaying protocol, providing methods to play and stop streaming audio.

classes.name: PCMStreamingAudioPlayer
classes.description: Class conforming to PCMStreamingAudioPlaying protocol, providing methods to play PCM streaming audio.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Begins playback of an async stream of Data, returning a StreamingPlaybackResult.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback, returning an optional Double (possibly the current playback time).
